LanguageData.RK_KingHamster.label: king hamster
LanguageData.RK_KingHamster.description: A giant, herd-living herbivore descended from hamsters and well adapted to both cold and warm climates. An enraged king hamster is dangerous, but once tamed it is a gentle animal that can carry loads. Nobody knows why king hamsters grew so large. They may be the legacy of early genetic engineering experiments.
LanguageData.RK_Leather_KingHamster.label: king hamster fur
LanguageData.RK_Leather_KingHamster.description: The thick, soft, beige pelt of a king hamster. Its excellent breathability helps regulate body temperature in hot climates.
LanguageData.RK_Wool_KingHamster.label: king hamster wool
LanguageData.RK_Wool_KingHamster.description: Soft, lightweight wool with excellent insulating properties. Clothing made from this wool is well suited to working in polar climates.
